title: Wire protocol definition
description: Documentation of the protocol layer for tool-shell communication.
body: Wire types for transport B — tool frontend <-> shell window messages. Mirrors `docs/tool-protocol.md` §3 exactly. Every message carries `kaava: 1`. It's a version marker, but its real job is cheaper: an iframe's `window` can receive `message` events from anything, not just its host (browser extensions, embedded widgets, the page's own code posting to itself) — `kaava === 1` is what lets the bridge ignore all of that in one check instead of trying to prove a message is safe to parse.
